items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: Like you, Mel, you're a very good friend of mine.

ctx.x: Like you, Mel, you're a very good friend of mine. Sure. And you have helped me a lot and I appreciate it. And when I play with you, you seem to put so much in your playing. You play from your heart. Right. And this makes me feel good. It just goes right through you from the top to the bottom. I mean, from your little tool look like it. I've seen you with those shoes. All the little tube you get to trickle when you're playing. And this is what it's all about.

Well, we appreciate you being around, George. And, well, it's interesting. Today you're, what, 73? No, I'm 71. 72? 71. God, the time is going by slowly. At any rate, it's great. Well, I hope you've been back to New Orleans. I hope you get back there again. And, you know, maybe you'll be at the New Orleans Jazz Festival this year. There's still some of your friends down there that are still playing. Yes. Who's still around down there?
